title: Delegated access paths & admin approval surface (RBAC v2)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: RBAC v1 exposed a flat roles surface that makes it hard for tenant admins to safely delegate permissions to team leads and auditors. Customers ask for: (1) an explicit delegation model where role assignments can be scoped and require optional approval, (2) a preview of effective permissions that surfaces transitive grants and resource boundaries, and (3) audit hooks when delegation flows are used so Security teams can track approvals and delegation history.

Goal: Design a role/permission editor UX that supports delegated assignments (temporary or permanent), an approval flow for high-risk grants, and a clear effective-permissions preview. The surface should minimize cognitive load for non-expert admins while enabling power-user controls (timebox, justification notes, escalation path). This ticket covers the exploratory surface, prototypes, interaction states, and handoff artifacts for engineering and PM.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype screens for: delegate assignment modal, approval request panel, effective-permissions preview, and audit breadcrumb slideout
Interaction spec covering: create delegation, request approval, approve/deny flow, auto-expiry enforcement, and revoke path
Accessible copy and labels for risk indicators with tooltip explanations for each permission category
Handoff-ready Figma frames with components exported and annotated for engineering
A mapping document that ties UI actions to audit log events (strings to be emitted) and to RBAC backend endpoints
decisions: Keep role templates as first-class but allow per-assignment overrides via delegation wrapper
Treat delegation as an assignment object (assignee, scope, expiration, justification, approver) recorded in audit logs
Show effective permissions preview with a collapsed and expanded mode to reduce initial complexity
High-risk perms (admin.* write operations, KMS access, private model deploy) will require optional approval when delegation is created and always surface a risk badge
discussion: Trade-offs: exposing too many permission details overwhelms tenant admins — use progressive disclosure and a default summarized risk level
Performance: effective-permissions preview requires backend resolution; agree on a cache TTL with engineering to avoid UX latency
Fallback: when approval service unreachable, delegate creation should queue an approval request and mark assignment 'pending' rather than silently granting
Edge cases: delegated assignment to groups vs individual users; prefer group-first UX with ability to expand into members
review_feedback: PM (Diego Ramos): prioritize audit log bindings for legal/compliance customers; include a unique delegation id in events
Security (Priya Anand): require justification text for delegation that grants write-level or export permissions
Engineering (Samir Patel): backend will emit events: delegation.created, delegation.requested_approval, delegation.approved, delegation.revoked — need UI mapping
next_steps: Iterate Figma frames with summary/expanded states and hand to ENG for performance gating
Convene a 30-minute sync with Security and Backend on audit event strings and retention expectations
Produce content for tooltip copy and help center article explaining delegation and approvals
Add telemetry hooks: track delegate creation, approval rate, revoke frequency (privacy-safe counts)
